functions.name: check_commerce_health
functions.title: Check commerce credentials status
functions.description: Reports the live connection status for Printful, Printify, Shopify and Gmail — which API secrets are configured, which resolve to a real store/shop, and which are in demo/sandbox fallback mode. Call this to verify the commerce integration configuration before testing catalog or order flows.

functions.name: read_printify_catalog
functions.title: Read Printify catalog
functions.description: Reads the LOKIN Printify store. Pass action 'shops' to list shops, 'catalog' (with shop_id) for the enriched product catalog with min/max prices, or 'product' (with shop_id + id) for a single product's variants. Returns demo-flagged sample data when the real PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN is not configured.

action.description: One of: shops, products, product, catalog. Read-only storefront reads.

shop_id.description: Printify shop id; required for products/product/catalog. Use the id returned by the 'shops' action.

id.description: Product id; required for the 'product' action.

functions.name: read_shopify_catalog
functions.title: Read Shopify catalog
functions.description: Reads the LOKIN Shopify store. Pass action 'shop' for store info, 'catalog' for the enriched product list with min/max prices, or 'product' (with id) for a single product's variants. Returns demo-flagged sample data when SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN or SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN is not configured.

action.description: One of: shop, products, product, catalog. Read-only storefront reads.

id.description: Product id; required for the 'product' action.

functions.name: printful_account_status
functions.title: Printful account status
functions.description: Reads the connected LOKIN Printful account. Pass action 'stores' to list every store owned by the configured PRINTFUL_API_TOKEN (returns id + name + type), or 'store' for the current store's full info (admin only). Use this first to resolve the storeId the other Printful tools need when a token owns more than one store. The real PRINTFUL_API_TOKEN is already configured server-side.

action.description: One of: stores, store. 'stores' is open to any user; 'store' is admin only.

storeId.description: Printful store id; required for 'store' when the token owns more than one store. Use the id returned by the 'stores' action.

functions.name: read_printful_catalog
functions.title: Read Printful catalog
functions.description: Reads the LOKIN Printful storefront catalog. Pass action 'products' (with storeId) for the paginated sync-product list, 'product' (with storeId + id) for a single product's variants with pricing and images, or 'catalog' for the enriched all-products view with min/max prices. Read-only.

action.description: One of: products, product, catalog. Read-only storefront reads.

storeId.description: Printful store id; required for products/product/catalog when the token owns more than one store.

id.description: Product id; required for the 'product' action.

limit.description: Max products for 'products' (1–100, default 50) or 'catalog' (1–200, default 200).

functions.name: printful_stock
functions.title: Check Printful stock
functions.description: Checks real-time stock availability for one or more Printful sync variants by variant id. Pass an array of numeric variant ids (up to 100). Read-only; any logged-in user.

storeId.description: Printful store id when the token owns more than one store.

ids.description: Array of Printful sync_variant ids to check (1–100).

functions.name: printful_orders
functions.title: Read Printful orders
functions.description: Reads LOKIN Printful orders and shipments (admin only). Pass action 'orders' for a paginated order list (optionally filtered by status) with fulfillment status and tracking, or 'order' (with id) for a single order's full detail including line items, costs, and shipment tracking. Use this to answer 'where is my order' or 'what's the tracking number'.

storeId.description: Printful store id when the token owns more than one store.

id.description: Order id or external id; required for the 'order' action.

status.description: Optional order status filter for 'orders' (e.g. draft, pending, inprocess, fulfilled, canceled).

functions.name: printful_warehouse
functions.title: Browse Printful warehouse blanks
functions.description: Browses the Printful blank-product warehouse catalog (the base garments/items before artwork). Pass action 'warehouse' for a paginated list of blank products with brand, model, image, and available variant ids. Read-only; any logged-in user. Use the variant_id from a blank here to create a sync product via printful_create_product.

functions.name: printful_create_product
functions.title: Create Printful product
functions.description: Creates a new sync product in the LOKIN Printful store from a Printful warehouse blank (admin only). Provide a product name, the warehouse blank's variant_id (from printful_warehouse), a retail_price (string e.g. '24.99'), and optionally a design file URL + placement (front/back). The product appears in the Printful store and storefront catalog immediately.

storeId.description: Printful store id when the token owns more than one store.

name.description: Display name for the new sync product.

variant_id.description: Printful warehouse blank variant_id to base the product on (from printful_warehouse).

retail_price.description: Retail price as a string, e.g. '24.99'. Must be >= 0.50 in the store currency.

file_url.description: Optional design artwork file URL. Omit to create a blank product and add art later in Printful.

placement.description: Optional print placement when file_url is set (e.g. front, back). Defaults to 'front'.

functions.name: optimize_route
functions.title: Optimize delivery route
functions.description: Runs LOKIN's route optimizer for the signed-in driver. Pass mode (fastest, most_profit, most_money, goal_mode, low_stress, minimum_mileage, homeward). Returns the ranked stop sequence, route stats (miles, gross, fuel, net, $/hr), today's earnings, and the Lock In Score.

functions.name: ask_lokin
functions.title: Ask the LOKIN AI assistant
functions.description: Asks the LOKIN AI voice assistant a question or request on behalf of the signed-in driver (e.g. 'what should I do next', 'tell my customer I'm 5 min away'). Returns a short reply and, for customer-comms requests, a drafted message to confirm sending.

functions.name: open_lokin
functions.title: Open LOKIN via Siri or Google Assistant
functions.description: Returns the deep-link URL, custom scheme, and exact Siri / Google Assistant voice phrases to launch a specific LOKIN screen (route, lokin assistant, earnings, home) on a device with the native app installed. Use this when the driver asks to open LOKIN by voice or wants a tappable launch link for Siri or Google Assistant.

target.description: Which LOKIN screen to launch. Defaults to route.
